textual_definition: A phenotype classification applying to a plant or plant-derived material bearer by virtue of an observable or measurable feature of a plant continuant, or of a plant process in which the bearer participates.
logical_pattern_or_constraint: Keep the root itself free of an explicit BFO superclass; its descendants classify material bearers and use BFO/RO-compatible relations to continuant or occurrent targets.
migration_note: Definition-only clarification; no obsoletion because the intended referent and existing extension are preserved.

textual_definition: A flora phenotype whose distinguishing feature inheres in a plant continuant, including a whole plant, plant anatomical entity, plant substance, or plant anatomical space.
logical_pattern_or_constraint: Use has_part only between continuants; a canonical structural pattern is has_part some (plant continuant and RO:0000053 has characteristic some PATO:0000001 descendant other than a process characteristic).
migration_note: Reparent existing PHENO|PO and EQ|PO|PATO classes here by the BFO/PO category of the target, without changing their identifiers.

textual_definition: A plant continuant-target phenotype whose distinguishing feature inheres in a plant anatomical entity or one of its parts.
logical_pattern_or_constraint: Target is_a PO:0025131 plant anatomical entity.
migration_note: Structural parent for existing entity-specific phenotype roots.

textual_definition: A plant anatomical entity phenotype whose distinguishing feature inheres in a whole plant or one of its parts.
logical_pattern_or_constraint: Retain the existing PHENO|PO_0000003 logical definition.
migration_note: Add the new structural parent; do not obsolete.

textual_definition: A plant anatomical entity phenotype whose distinguishing feature inheres in a plant structure or one of its parts.
logical_pattern_or_constraint: Target is_a PO:0009011 plant structure.
migration_note: Reuse the original FLOPO identifier and reparent structure-specific phenotype roots beneath it; obsolete duplicate FLOPO:0980419 with a replacement link.

textual_definition: A plant anatomical entity phenotype whose distinguishing feature inheres in a portion of plant substance or one of its parts.
logical_pattern_or_constraint: Retain PHENO|PO_0025161; add only the new structural parent.
migration_note: Repair and extend the existing branch; do not duplicate or obsolete it.

textual_definition: A plant continuant-target phenotype whose distinguishing feature concerns a plant anatomical space or its boundary.
logical_pattern_or_constraint: Do not treat an anatomical space as a material entity; use the PO anatomical-space hierarchy as target.
migration_note: Reuse the original FLOPO identifier and reparent space-specific phenotype roots beneath it; obsolete duplicate FLOPO:0980420 with a replacement link.

textual_definition: A plant anatomical entity phenotype whose distinguishing feature concerns a collection of plant material entities considered together without requiring them to form one connected structure.
logical_pattern_or_constraint: Do not equate this branch with PO:0025497 collective plant structure, whose members must be adjacent; use BFO:0000115 has member part for aggregate membership.
evidence: BFO 2020 object aggregate; BFO:0000115; PO:0025497 boundary
migration_note: Parent for foliage phenotype and future distributed plant collections.

textual_definition: A flora phenotype whose distinguishing feature is a feature of a plant biological process in which a plant bearer participates.
logical_pattern_or_constraint: Never use has_part from a material plant bearer to a process. Complete Manchester template: FLOPO:<class> EquivalentTo BFO:0000051 some (<PO bearer> and RO:0000056 some (<GO:0008150 descendant> and RO:0000053 some <PATO:0001236 descendant>)).
migration_note: This branch replaces the old invalid pattern that made any material bearer with a process characteristic unsatisfiable.

textual_definition: A plant occurrent-target phenotype whose distinguishing feature inheres in a biological process involving a plant bearer.
logical_pattern_or_constraint: Within the outer BFO:0000051 restriction, use RO:0000056 to link the explicit PO bearer to a GO process and RO:0000053 to link that process to a PATO process characteristic; RO:0000086 has quality is continuant-specific.
migration_note: Migrate process-characteristic terms only after identifying their PO bearer and GO process target and validating satisfiability.

textual_definition: The imported hierarchy of characteristics used to describe an entity, process, or aspect of an entity or process.
logical_pattern_or_constraint: Do not place PATO classes or FLOPO-local PATO extensions below flora phenotype; they remain characteristics and serve as fillers in phenotype definitions.
migration_note: Replace the proposed phenotypic-aspect facet with the actual PATO hierarchy. No new FLOPO quality root is minted.

textual_definition: A characteristic that inheres in a single physical object.
logical_pattern_or_constraint: Morphology, colour, texture, disposition, relational qualities, cardinality, and local extensions remain in their appropriate PATO branches.
migration_note: Use PATO ancestry or queries over logical fillers for quality-based navigation rather than duplicating morphology and appearance phenotype branches.

textual_definition: A characteristic that inheres in a process.
logical_pattern_or_constraint: Use only as a characteristic of a GO process through RO:0000053, never as a characteristic of the participating plant continuant.
migration_note: Local process-characteristic extensions are parented here or under a more specific PATO descendant.

textual_definition: A process specifically pertinent to the functioning of integrated living units, with a defined beginning and end.
logical_pattern_or_constraint: Build a pinned GO module containing every referenced biological-process class and its required ancestors; do not place GO classes below flora phenotype.
migration_note: The released FLOPO currently imports PO and PATO but contains no GO class; add GO support only after module and reasoner validation.

textual_definition: A provisional biological-process class needed for flora annotation when no current GO class has the required meaning.
logical_pattern_or_constraint: Give the class a FLOPO IRI but assert it below the closest GO process class, cite a definition, mark it as local/provisional, and request an upstream GO class when the concept is broadly reusable.
evidence: GO term guidance; OBO term-stability policy
migration_note: This is a modeling policy, not a superclass named FLOPO extension and not a phenotype class.

textual_definition: A relational cardinality quality inhering in a compound leaf by virtue of the leaf having exactly three leaflets.
logical_pattern_or_constraint: Toward PO:0020049 leaflet; local support class, not a new PO anatomical entity.
migration_note: Mark as FLOPO-local with an editorial annotation, not by inventing a biological superclass called FLOPO extension.

textual_definition: A leaf phenotype in which the bearer is a compound leaf with exactly three leaflets.
logical_pattern_or_constraint: RO:0002180 has component exactly 3 PO:0020049 and bearer RO:0000053 has characteristic some LOCAL:trifoliolate_quality; remove FLOPO:0000149 leaf shape parent.
migration_note: Correct in place because the intended botanical referent remains unchanged; quality-based navigation follows the PATO filler.

textual_definition: A relational cardinality quality inhering in a compound leaf by virtue of the leaf having exactly two leaflets.
logical_pattern_or_constraint: Toward PO:0020049 leaflet; local support class.
migration_note: New FLOPO-local quality.

textual_definition: A leaf phenotype in which the bearer is a compound leaf with exactly two leaflets.
logical_pattern_or_constraint: RO:0002180 has component exactly 2 PO:0020049 and bearer RO:0000053 has characteristic some LOCAL:bifoliolate_quality.
migration_note: New FLOPO phenotype; no PO class request. Quality-based navigation follows the PATO filler.

textual_definition: A disposition inhering in a plant structure by virtue of its capacity to deliver an irritating portion of plant substance to an animal when contacted or broken.
logical_pattern_or_constraint: Do not equate the disposition with being sharp, hollow, glandular, or poisonous; those require independent evidence.
migration_note: New FLOPO-local quality.

textual_definition: A trichome phenotype in which the trichome has the disposition to deliver an irritating portion of plant substance to an animal upon contact or breakage.
logical_pattern_or_constraint: Target PO:0000282 trichome RO:0000053 has characteristic some LOCAL:stinging_disposition; do not assert universal PO:0004509 glandular-trichome parent.
migration_note: New FLOPO phenotype; no PO class request. Quality-based navigation follows the PATO disposition filler.

textual_definition: A plant anatomical entity consisting of the leaves borne by one whole plant or shoot system at a specified time, considered collectively.
logical_pattern_or_constraint: BFO:0000115 has member part some PO:0025034 leaf and BFO:0000115 has member part only PO:0025034 leaf; do not require adjacency or connectedness.
migration_note: New FLOPO-local entity because PO's available collective-structure parent is too restrictive.

textual_definition: A plant material aggregate phenotype whose distinguishing feature concerns foliage or one of its member leaves.
logical_pattern_or_constraint: Use LOCAL:foliage_entity as target after the membership pattern is validated.
migration_note: New FLOPO branch.

textual_definition: A portion of plant substance that is the cytoplasmic fluid of laticifer cells, commonly containing particles suspended or emulsified in an aqueous phase and capable of exuding when laticiferous tissue is damaged.
logical_pattern_or_constraint: Keep distinct from PO:0025538 plant sap. Avoid universal colour, milkiness, stickiness, or current-location-in-laticifer restrictions.
migration_note: New FLOPO-local entity supporting the existing latex phenotype branch.

textual_definition: A portion of plant substance phenotype whose distinguishing feature concerns plant latex.
logical_pattern_or_constraint: Use LOCAL:plant_latex_entity as target; develop FLOPO:0900049--0900051 with explicit presence and absence semantics.
migration_note: Repair existing branch in place; no duplicate phenotype class.

textual_definition: A whole-plant phenotype distinguished by the characteristic architecture, support habit, or persistence of the whole plant and its principal shoot system.
logical_pattern_or_constraint: Existing arborescent, frutescent, lianescent, and herbaceous descendants require evidence-backed definitions and sense separation; retain their PATO characteristics and external relata explicitly in logical definitions.
migration_note: Develop the existing branch rather than coin atomic PO or PATO growth-form entities; derive quality-based views from logical fillers.
